question: What can the DJI Matrice 30T be set to do when the remote controller signal is lost?

intake.focus: DJI Matrice 30T lost RC signal behavior
intake.reason: Question asks what guidance/manuals say about lost control link and subsequent aircraft/pilot actions

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance: reestablish the control link or initiate emergency/contingency loss-of-control procedures. Manufacturer manuals: actions can be set to RTH, land, or hover; RTH auto-activates after six seconds of lost RC signal; Original Route RTH can apply when lighting is poor or vision is unavailable; the aircraft remains in RTH even if RC signal is restored. Incident reports (unverified): claims include RTH at programmed altitude without issue, loss of all control, and RTH initiated but did not respond. Gaps/conflicts: conflicts between manual RTH behavior and incident claims; unclear causality linking loss of signal to RTH; no explicit, model-agnostic lost-link action list beyond reestablishing link and emergency procedures.

claims.text: If the control link becomes degraded or delayed, commanders should 'Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft,' to ensure reliable communications.
